retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait layout featuring a visible CMYK halftone screen and bold red rectangular text blocks.
excludeWhen: modern flat vector styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a male subject with a warm, yellowish skin tone, processed with a heavy, visible halftone dot pattern. The composition is anchored by a vertical black bar on the left containing stacked red rectangular text blocks with white and black sans-serif and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Text blocks are strictly aligned to a left-side vertical axis
Halftone texture scale is large enough to be a primary stylistic element
High-contrast lighting creates deep shadows in the subject's features
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern across the entire image
Solid red rectangular backgrounds for all text elements
Extreme close-up cropping that cuts off the top and sides of the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies 80% of the frame, shifted slightly right, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large red square in the upper-left corner containing stylized initials.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large red block in the top left, down the vertical black bar, then across the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A solid black vertical strip on the far left provides a high-contrast foundation for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and peach tones in the halftone portrait.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the side bar and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the geometric text containers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red blocks contrasts with the textured, mid-value skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Red, Black, White, and a warm Yellow/Orange spectrum

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast Didone serif for initials and condensed grotesque for body text.
letterConstructionRules: Initials must be extremely tall and compressed with hairline serifs
Secondary text must be all-caps and fit tightly within red bars
No letter spacing (tracking) for the large initials
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' in the initials uses a double-V construction with overlapping strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a decorative, vertical serif and a functional, horizontal sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of the initials
Matches the sturdy, all-caps sans-serif for the red bars

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a man with a mustache, apply a heavy CMYK halftone screen filter, and add a solid black vertical bar on the left 20% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large red square in the top left. Inside it, type two large initials in a white condensed serif font. Below, place four horizontal red bars on the black strip, each containing one line of black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern clearly visible?
Are the text blocks solid red with no transparency?
Is the portrait cropped tightly on the face?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Christopher Williams'
Do not use the specific 'CW' logo mark

mustAchieve: Strict geometric alignment of text blocks
avoid: Soft edges on the red blocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the red background
Verify the halftone effect doesn't obscure the subject's eyes
Check that the black sidebar is perfectly vertical
Confirm the initials are vertically elongated
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Halftone Filter + Black Sidebar + Red Block Typography
